_about: Machine-readable canonical PUBLIC FACTS for piia-engram. This is the single source of truth that scripts/check_public_fact_sync.py enforces against the current-state public documentation surfaces. Update this file (and re-run the guard) whenever the numbers below change. See docs/runbooks/public-truth-sync.md.
release_frame: These are LOCAL DEV facts for the working tree as of last_verified_date. Public registries (PyPI, MCP Registry, Glama, Smithery, LobeHub) reflect the last PUBLISHED release and only change during an actual publish/release. A gap between this manifest and a public registry is EXPECTED between releases and is not in-repo drift to fix by editing docs.

sources.test_collected: pytest tests/ --collect-only -q  ->  '<N> tests collected'  (invariant: test_passed + test_skipped == test_collected)
sources.mcp_tools_total: python scripts/count_mcp_tools.py --json -> .total (AST count of @mcp.tool() async defs in src/piia_engram/mcp_server.py; equals ENGRAM_TOOLS=all registration)
sources.mcp_tools_core: python scripts/count_mcp_tools.py --json -> .core (size of the TIER1_TOOLS frozenset in mcp_server.py, loaded by default when ENGRAM_TOOLS is unset / 'core')
sources.telemetry_default: PRIVACY.md and docs/telemetry-privacy.md: telemetry is off by default (inspect PRIVACY.md 'Off by default' language)
sources.telemetry_remote_default: PRIVACY.md: remote telemetry is a separate explicit opt-in, off by default (inspect 'engram telemetry remote on/off' language)
